name: ragcode
description: Local semantic code intelligence over MCP: semantic and exact search, usages, call hierarchy, package exports and file context. Indexes Go, PHP (and Blade), Python, JavaScript/TypeScript (and Vue), GDScript, HTML with Go templates, and Markdown/JSON/YAML/TOML docs into an embedded SQLite index per workspace; embeddings through a local Ollama model.

http.description: Streamable HTTP. Start with -http 127.0.0.1:39000 and configure the IDE with url: http://127.0.0.1:39000/mcp

ollama.description: Ollama 0.40 or later with the embeddinggemma-2:270m embedding model

tools.name: rag_search
tools.description: Search the indexed code: exact match by (qualified) name when the query is an identifier, semantic search otherwise. Results carry file, lines, kind and score; compact when there are more than 4 unless full=true.

tools.name: rag_find_usages
tools.description: Every indexed reference to a symbol (calls, extends, implements, uses), grouped by file with the calling symbol and the call line.

tools.name: rag_call_hierarchy
tools.description: Callers (incoming) and callees (outgoing) of a function as a tree, up to depth 4.

tools.name: rag_list_package_exports
tools.description: The exported symbols of a package or module, grouped by kind.

tools.name: rag_read_file_context
tools.description: Read a file of the workspace: a symbol with its relations, a line range, or the outline plus the first 120 lines.

tools.name: rag_index_workspace
tools.description: Index the workspace. Without confirm=true it only reports what would be indexed. mode=incremental re-indexes changed files; mode=recreate drops the collection and re-embeds everything.

tools.name: rag_server_info
tools.description: Server version, uptime, Ollama reachability, update availability, registered languages and known workspaces.

-http.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this address instead of stdio

-log-level.description: debug, info, warn or error (overrides the config)

-uninstall.description: Remove RagCode MCP from this machine and exit

RAGCODE_ALLOWED_PATHS.description: Allowed workspace paths, as an OS path list
